name: Websync Builder for Contact Form 7
author: Whistleblowing Form Team

sections.description:
Websync Builder for Contact Form 7 transforms the traditional shortcode-based form editing into a modern visual experience. No more memorizing field syntax or toggling between previews — build and preview your forms live.

With this plugin, you can:
– Build CF7 forms with a drag-and-drop interface
– See live form previews without switching screens
– Manage and view form submissions directly in your WordPress dashboard
– (Pro) Redirect users to a thank-you page or any URL after form submission
– (Pro) Multi-step forms for Contact Form 7
– Reorder, group, and customize fields easily
– Keep full compatibility with CF7 styling and third-party extensions

Key Features:
– Full support for all Contact Form 7 field types (text, email, select, radio, checkbox, date, file, quiz, acceptance, etc.)
– Submissions management for easy access to sent form data
– Redirect after submit option for custom thank-you pages (Pro)
– Multi-step forms for Contact Form 7 (Pro)
– Works with any WordPress theme
– Developer and beginner friendly

Whether you’re a developer or a site owner, this plugin makes form creation with Contact Form 7 fast and intuitive.

Note: This plugin requires Contact Form 7 to be installed and activated.

Credits

Contact us!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/websync-builder-cf7/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and active.
  4. Go to Contact > Your form > Visual Builder to start using the visual builder.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace Contact Form 7?

No, it works alongside Contact Form 7 by providing a visual UI for building forms with drag and drop.

Can I edit existing CF7 forms in the builder?

You can import and visually edit most standard CF7 forms. Some advanced customizations may need manual shortcode edits.

Will it break my existing forms?

No, existing forms remain intact unless explicitly edited via the builder.
